name: Stand By Me
source:
After a deadly accident, you wake up in the unfamiliar land of Desideria, assuming the equally unfamiliar identity of Ciel Rozenbleu - a sorceress in the royal military.

It’s your life now. A new path will be carved by your hands.

The world of Stand by Me is set in the Una Continent which is made up of three countries:

Desideria, a powerful empire well-versed in elemental magic. Their current goal is to conquer Idris and unite the Una continent. 
Cantara, a Desiderian colony that lacks magical expertise but specialises in technology.
Idris, a hunter-gatherer civilisation that possesses a powerful form of magic that manipulates mana and life force-- Priroda. 
With no knowledge of your new identity and the world around you, you stumble about (barely) fulfilling the original Ciel's role in the military. 

But being a modern misfit in this archaic fantasy world, you  begin to form your own opinions on the harshness of Desideria’s operations and rethink your allegiance. 

Who will you choose to stand by?

[From [url=https://fishattic.itch.io/stand-by-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一场致命事故之后，你在陌生的德西德里亚大陆醒来，并承担了同样陌生的身份：夏尔·罗森布鲁 (Ciel Rozenbleu)——皇家军队中的女巫。

现在是你的生活了。新的道路将由你的双手开辟。

《Stand by Me》的世界设定在由三个国家组成的乌纳大陆：

德西迪亚，一个精通元素魔法的强大帝国。他们目前的目标是征服伊德里斯并统一乌纳大陆。
坎塔拉，一个缺乏魔法专长但专注于科技的德赛德殖民地。
伊德里斯是一个狩猎采集文明，拥有一种可以操纵法力和生命力的强大魔法——普里罗达。
由于不了解自己的新身份和周围的世界，你（勉强）跌跌撞撞地履行了最初的夏尔在军队中的角色。

但作为一个与这个古老的奇幻世界格格不入的现代人，你开始对黛西利亚的严酷运作形成自己的看法，并重新考虑你的效忠对象。

你会选择站在谁一边？

[来自[url=https://fishattic.itch.io/stand-by-me]itch.io[/url]]
